product: Design-led hardware platform solutions plus electronics manufacturing, supply-chain, logistics and after-market services, split into Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (communications, enterprise servers and storage) and Advanced Technology Solutions (aerospace and defense, industrial, healthtech, capital equipment).
demand: Unprecedented multi-year AI data-center demand. CCS revenue grew 84% year over year in Q2 2026 and management cited the strongest demand outlook in company history with 2027 growth accelerating.
pricing_power: Mixed. Operating leverage and richer mix lifted adjusted operating margin to a record 8.2%, but the 10-Q cites price reductions, longer payment terms, commodity and component cost inflation and margins at risk if costs cannot be passed through.
competition: Competes with EMS and ODM players, and the 10-Q warns that the pace of AI-driven technology change and customers transferring or outsourcing business among EMS and ODM competitors can hurt results. Data-center deployments drive revenue variability.
team: Rob Mionis is Chair and CEO. Effective Oct 1 2026 Mandeep Chawla becomes Group President, Global Markets, and Todd Ankenmann becomes CFO; Steven Dorwart took over CCS on Jul 6 2026; about 29,591 employees.
market_strategy: Scale capacity and capabilities to capture the multi-year AI infrastructure build-out, funded by a $3.45B equity raise for working capital and capex, focused on high-performance AI compute and data-center Ethernet networking programs with hyperscale customers.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $4.70B (+62% y/y), record 8.2% adj op margin, 2026 outlook raised to $20.5B/$11.30 EPS; CCS +84% y/y on AI data-center demand; $3.45B raise funds capacity.
bear: Top-10 customers 83% of revenue; gross margin fell to 12.3% from 12.8%; GAAP EPS aided by $0.90 swap gain; 63-day momentum negative; 21% below high; price reductions and longer payment terms cited.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results (Oct 26-27 2026) showing revenue below the raised $20.5B annual run-rate or adjusted operating margin under 8.2%.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 results Jul 27 2026: revenue $4.70B (+62% y/y), adj EPS $2.54, adj op margin 8.2% record; 2026 outlook raised to $20.5B revenue and $11.30 adj EPS, 2027 growth to accelerate. Aug 5 2026 priced $3B equity offering at $310/share, completed Aug 7 raising $3.45B gross. Leadership changes Jul 6 and Sep 11 2026.
web_not_known_yesterday: Nothing new. No company press release, filing or wire item dated Sep 24 or Sep 25 2026 was found; 30-day news count is zero. Only fresh item is pre-market trading on Sep 25 2026 (about +1.34%, aggregator).
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Demand and volume led, with mix help. CCS revenue rose 84% y/y to $3.81B and Hardware Platform Solutions ~$1.9B rose 58%; ATS rose only 8%. Margin gain came from operating leverage and richer HPS/CCS mix, not from price; 10-Q flags price reductions and longer payment terms.
web_suppliers: No named suppliers. 10-Q says improved component supply eased constraints, but still cites risk from silicon and component availability, supplier performance and quality, and supplier pricing and terms. Suppliers are large and not currently described as the binding constraint.
web_customers: Extremely concentrated. Top 10 customers were 83% of Q2 2026 revenue (78% a year earlier). Three CCS customers each exceeded 10% of revenue at 32%, 17% and 14%. Prior-year top two were 31% and 13%. Customers are hyperscale/AI data-center accounts.
web_who_loses: EMS and ODM rivals that lose share as customers outsource or move business among competitors, per the 10-Q. Branded networking/systems vendors displaced by hyperscaler white-box hardware platform solutions. Existing holders were diluted by 11,129,031 new shares from the August offering.
web_contradicting_evidence: Gross margin slipped to 12.3% in Q2 2026 from 12.8% a year earlier. GAAP EPS included a $0.90/share non-operating total return swap gain. Shares closed Sep 24 2026 at 373.56, about 21% below the 474.03 52-week high; 63-day momentum is negative. GuruFocus GF Value of $190.82 versus price flags overvaluation.
web_if_management_right: 2026 revenue reaches $20.5B (+65%) and adjusted EPS $11.30 (+87%), free cash flow $600M, adjusted operating margin 8.4%, and 2027 revenue growth accelerates above 65% with EPS growing faster, funded by the $3.45B raise and AI data-center capex.
web_if_management_wrong: Customer forecasts and program ramps slip, so the record 83% top-10 concentration transmits one customer cut straight to revenue. New capacity and capex funded by the equity raise sit underused, price and mix pressure compress margin, and GAAP EPS drops as the total return swap gain reverses.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Merchant AI networking and compute silicon, optics, and power and thermal vendors feeding Celestica 800G and 1.6T networking plus AI/ML compute programs; data-center construction and equipment suppliers absorbing its capex; EMS peers and their suppliers. Named vendors were not disclosed, so this is inference from the 10-Q program language.
